@paint.texture.tooltip: Second line of the tooltip of a ground texture tile on the Paint tab; the first line is the name of the texture (a file name), so keep this short
paint.hint: Choose a texture and paint where it should show. A texture painted later covers the ones before it; the first one is the ground the whole map starts as.
paint.mode.paint.tooltip: Lays the chosen texture on and takes textures painted over it away under the brush
paint.mode.erase.tooltip: Takes the chosen texture away, so the one beneath shows
paint.mode.soften.tooltip: Blurs the edge of the chosen texture for a soft transition
paint.hardness.tooltip: How much of the brush's radius paints fully; the rest fades out into a soft transition
@paint.row.mode: Label of a row in the terrain tool's option column, at most about 9 characters: its icons choose how the brush paints (paint, erase, soften)
@paint.row.tile: Label of a row in the terrain tool's option column, at most about 9 characters: its icons act on a whole tile (cover it, clear it) or add a texture; a tile is a square piece of the map
paint.cover.tooltip: Turns the pointer into a paint bucket: click a tile to cover it completely with the chosen texture. Click the button again or press Esc to stop
paint.clear.tooltip: Turns the pointer into a tile eraser: click a tile to take the chosen texture off it. Click the button again or press Esc to stop
paint.add.tooltip: Adds a texture from the OMSI installation's Texture folder to this map
paint.status.failed: The ground could not be painted: {reason}
@paint.hint.cover: Hint line in the status bar while the Cover tile mode is on; {texture} is the name of the chosen ground texture (a file name). A tile is a square piece of the map
@paint.hint.clear: Hint line in the status bar while the Clear tile mode is on; {texture} is the name of the chosen ground texture (a file name). A tile is a square piece of the map
@paint.status.disarmed: Status text when Esc ends the mode that covers or clears a tile by click
paint.hint.cover: Click tiles to cover them with {texture}. Esc stops.
paint.hint.clear: Click tiles to clear {texture} from them. Esc stops.
